facts.text: FPT was founded in Vietnam in 1988 and is headquartered in Hanoi; it operates in over 30 countries. Its representative is Truong Gia Binh, whom FPT's own releases call founder and chairman.
facts.ja: 御社グループは1988年にベトナムで創業され、現在は30以上の国で事業を展開されています。

facts.text: FY2025 (annual report): revenue VND 70,113 billion (+11.6%) and profit before tax VND 13,044 billion (+17.8%). IT services for foreign markets grew 14.3%, and the Japan market grew 25.4%. FPT's November 2026 release gives FY2025 revenue as USD 2.66 billion.
facts.ja: 2025年には、日本市場の売上が約25%伸びたと拝見しました。

facts.text: Headcount: 54,687 (December 2024, consolidated); a May 2026 release still says about 54,000. Counts differ by definition (FPT's November 2026 release cites 'over 37,000 engineers'), so say 5万人以上 rather than an exact number.
facts.ja: グループ全体で、5万人以上の社員が働いていると拝見しました。

facts.text: The April 2024 strategy named five focus areas for 2024–2026: AI, automotive, semiconductors, digital transformation and green transformation. Automotive goals: 50% yearly growth and USD 1 billion revenue by 2030, moving from software outsourcing toward technical design for software-defined vehicles (SDVs). This was a group-level announcement, so say 御社グループ.
facts.ja: 御社グループは2024年に、AIや自動車を重点分野にすると発表されました。

facts.text: From 2026, FPT says it will shift from its former main identity as a technology services provider to a 'technology innovation company'.
facts.ja: 2026年からは、技術革新を生み出す企業への転換を掲げていると拝見しました。

facts.text: Overseas IT services in 2025: revenue VND 35,382 billion (+14.3%); newly signed revenue VND 40,636 billion (+23.2%); AI and data analytics +41%; and FPT won its first contract in Japan worth over USD 100 million.
facts.ja: 2025年には、AIとデータ分析の分野が約41%伸びたと拝見しました。

facts.text: Official group core values: Respect, Innovation, Teammate, Fairness, Exemplarity, Assertiveness. Older English versions differ; in Japanese interviews, the FPT Japan values (One team, Challenge, Lifelong Learning) are more useful.
Do not confuse FPT Corporation with FPT Industrial, an unrelated Italian engine maker in the Iveco Group that appears in search results.

FPT Automotive was launched on 14 December 2023 in Texas as FPT's automotive technology subsidiary, with about 4,000 engineers at launch. Key markets: US, Europe, Japan, Korea, China and Vietnam. Aim: a billion-dollar provider by 2030.
facts.ja: FPTオートモーティブは、2023年に発足した車載ソフトウェアの会社だと理解しております。

facts.text: Tagline 'Accelerating software-defined vehicles'. Services include cockpit domain controller, AUTOSAR, ECU and virtual ECU, ADAS/AD, validation and verification, functional safety and cybersecurity, connected services, on-board chargers, charging systems and battery management systems. The site claims more than 150 customers among top OEMs, Tier 1 suppliers and chipmakers (a group-wide figure).
facts.ja: ADASからコックピットまで、幅広い車載ソフトウェアを手がけていると拝見しました。

facts.text: About 5,000 automotive software engineers worldwide (a group-wide figure, not Japan only). Certifications listed: ISO 26262, ISO/SAE 21434, ASIL A–D, TISAX and A-SPICE Level 3.
facts.ja: グループ全体で、約5,000人の車載ソフトウェア技術者がいると拝見しました。

facts.text: The 2025 annual report says several flagship programs, notably automotive technology, healthcare, data and cloud computing, passed USD 100 million in revenue for the first time. It gives no separate figure for automotive, so do not quote an exact automotive revenue.
facts.ja: 2025年には、自動車技術などの分野で、売上が初めて1億ドルを超えたと拝見しました。

facts.text: DENSO MoU (announced 13 December 2024, signed at DENSO's headquarters in Kariya, Aichi): collaboration on SDVs with an emphasis on mass-production ADAS projects, plus an offshore development center for human-resource development and training, with expansion planned by the end of 2027. The two companies first partnered in 2017. An MoU (覚書) is not a development contract.
facts.ja: デンソーとは2024年に、SDVの開発に関する覚書を結ばれたと拝見しました。

facts.text: Subaru: after an August 2024 MoU on digital transformation, FPT Automotive and Subaru renewed a two-year basic contract at the corporate level (announced March 2025), covering SDVs, autonomous driving and next-generation safety systems. FPT's technical experts are sent to Subaru's plants in Gunma for hands-on training.
facts.ja: スバルとの協業では、技術者が群馬の工場で研修を受けると拝見しました。

facts.text: Honda: a connected-car smartphone-app project (2021), then a June 2023 agreement to consider wider cooperation in IT services, including an offshore development center dedicated to Honda. The same release calls FPT the first Vietnamese firm to reach A-SPICE Level 3.

Mitsubishi Motors signed an MoU with FPT Japan Holdings (15 May 2026) to start discussions on collaboration in the software and digital domain, with a view to a possible joint venture. No timeline was given.

April 2024: FPT and NVIDIA announced a plan for a USD 200 million AI factory using NVIDIA's chips and software, to develop AI applications and solutions. Reuters named generative AI and autonomous driving among the target areas.
facts.ja: 2024年に、NVIDIAと約2億ドルのAIファクトリー計画を発表されています。

facts.text: FPT AI Factory was launched in Japan on 13 November 2024 at the NVIDIA AI Summit Japan. FPT is a Preferred NVIDIA Cloud Partner; the service runs on NVIDIA Hopper-generation GPUs (the release names the H200) and has three parts: FPT AI Infrastructure, FPT AI Studio and FPT AI Inference.
facts.ja: 御社グループは日本で、NVIDIAのGPUを使ったAIファクトリーを運営されています。

facts.text: FPT AI Factory Japan ranked #36 on the June 2025 TOP500 list of supercomputers (49.85 PFlop/s, NVIDIA H200 GPUs). Later lists rank it lower: #41 (November 2025), #50 (June 2026) and #56 (November 2026), so always say 2025年6月 with the rank.
facts.ja: 2025年6月には、スーパーコンピューターの世界ランキングで36位に入りました。

facts.text: FPT Smart Cloud Japan is the FPT subsidiary behind the FPT AI Factory business in Japan. In April 2025, Sumitomo Corporation and SBI Holdings agreed to invest 20% each (media reports say FPT keeps the remaining 60%) to offer GPU cloud resources and support 'sovereign AI' in Japan.
FPT opened the FPT Data & AI Integration Center in Japan (December 2024) and said it plans to recruit hundreds of AI experts and thousands of IT engineers in other fields.
facts.ja: 日本で、AIの専門人材の採用を増やす計画を発表されています。

facts.text: AI-Defined Mobility offering: a vehicle and fleet data platform; agentic AI at the edge on Qualcomm and NVIDIA SoCs; AI test automation (FPT claims 80% less vehicle-software test time); and a 'virtual factory' for automotive manufacturing.
facts.ja: 車載向けには、車の中でAIを動かす取り組みも進めていると拝見しました。

facts.text: FPT Japan's release of 18 November 2026 says FPT upholds 'AI First Company' and is promoting Physical AI, robotics and stronger AI infrastructure through FPT AI Factory, plus a 'Customer Zero' approach (testing technology in-house first). The English version adds that FPT supports Japan's AI sovereignty.
facts.ja: 御社は「AI First Company」を掲げ、フィジカルAIにも取り組まれています。

facts.text: At CES 2026, FPT showed AI-defined mobility demos, including a 'Smart AI Cabin' co-developed with Telechips and an edge AI orchestrator concept on Qualcomm and NVIDIA SoCs.

FPT's Japan company was established in November 2005 (now FPT Japan Holdings). FPT says it was the first Vietnamese IT company to establish a legal entity in Japan, and it marked 20 years in Japan in November 2025.
facts.ja: 御社は2005年から、20年以上日本で事業を続けていると拝見しました。

facts.text: More than 5,500 employees in Japan from 37 nationalities, in 18 offices and innovation hubs; 18,000 employees worldwide serve Japanese customers (English release, 18 November 2026; the Japanese release gives no headcount). A year earlier FPT cited nearly 5,000 employees of 28 nationalities, so re-check before each interview.
facts.ja: 日本では、37の国籍の社員が5,500人以上働いていると拝見しました。

facts.text: On 18 November 2026, FPT Japan announced that its revenue in Japan had reached ¥100 billion (Japanese release: 日本市場で売上高1,000億円を達成; the English release says it 'surpassed ¥100 billion in annual revenue'). No fiscal period is stated, so give the year of the announcement.
facts.ja: 2026年に、日本での売上高が1,000億円に達したと発表されています。

facts.text: Goal stated in FPT's English release of 18 November 2026: to rank among Japan's top 13 IT companies by 2033 (earlier goal: top 15 by 2027). The Japanese release does not mention it, so present it as something you read.
facts.ja: 2033年までに、日本のIT企業トップ13に入ることを目指すと拝見しました。

facts.text: Brand message 「日本の元気をITから」. Business: end-to-end services from consulting to development, operations and maintenance, in areas such as AI, cloud, ERP, data and legacy modernization. The release describes FPT as a bridge connecting Japan and Vietnam (日本とベトナムをつなぐ架け橋). The English release of the same day adds that FPT's current focus in Japan includes AI and automotive.
facts.ja: 『日本の元気をITから』というメッセージに、共感しております。

facts.text: FPT Automotive Japan (FA, FPTオートモティブジャパン事業本部) is FPT Software's specialist organisation for Japan's automotive industry. It serves OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers in embedded software, ADAS, autonomous driving and in-vehicle infotainment (IVI). Experienced engineers at its Japan and Vietnam sites work together through onsite, offshore and nearshore delivery. Another FA posting says the working language is Japanese (公用語は日本語).
facts.ja: 日本とベトナムの技術者が連携して開発し、社内の公用語は日本語だと拝見しました。

facts.text: FPT Gunma Mobility DX Hub (ＦＰＴ群馬モビリティDXハブ) opened in Ota City in December 2024 as a base for DX support for automotive-related companies. President Do Van Khac said Ota has many automotive companies, starting with SUBARU.
facts.ja: 自動車産業が集まる群馬県太田市にも、拠点を開設されています。

facts.text: FPT's Japanese subsidiary won the top 'Best Workplace' rating at the D&I AWARD in 2024 and 2025 (two years in a row).
facts.ja: D&I AWARDで、2年連続でベストワークプレイスに選ばれています。

facts.text: 2027年卒 engineer posting (Tokyo, FPT Software Japan): Japanese at N2 level or above; TOEIC 650 or willingness to reach it; about 3 months of external training (business manners to programming basics); monthly pay guideline ¥250,000. Work includes next-generation technology (AI, IoT and others) and DX support; clients include automakers, and client-site work is possible. Preferred: thinks and acts independently, has a personal axis (軸), is eager to take on challenges, understands global environments. Selection steps are not published.
facts.ja: 自分の軸を持ち、挑戦意欲のある人を求めていると拝見しました。

facts.text: New-graduate page (2027/2028): the training programme aims for new hires to become, within one year, IT professionals who can act as a bridge between customers and the development team. FPT Japan Persona values: One team, Challenge, Lifelong Learning. 'AI engineer' is listed without details, and internships are listed for manufacturing and automotive engineers.
facts.ja: 御社の研修は、1年以内にお客様と開発チームの架け橋になることが目標だと拝見しました。

facts.text: Long-term Engineer (AI / manufacturing / automotive) internship for 28卒 and 29卒: 2 weeks or more during long holidays at the Tokyo head office; data collection, preprocessing, analysis, model building and visualization. For students at universities in Japan with about 2+ years of Python or other programming and Japanese at native or N2+ level. Selection is an interview with a department manager; 10 places; listed as leading to early selection.

The only published new-graduate flow (FCJ consultants, 28卒): online briefing, document screening, aptitude test, 1st interview with HR (online), 2nd with a manager (online), final with an executive (in person). The engineer flow is not published, so prepare for 3 or more rounds.

FAQ: about 1–1.5 months from application to offer (about 2 months for some roles); 6-month probation; evaluation is based on goals (OKRs) that employees set themselves each year and quarter. The FAQ gives a company-wide average of 11 overtime hours a month, but only for FY2021 (old data).

Experienced-hire 'FPT Automotive AI Engineer' (Kobe preferred, or Nagoya): a front SE / bridge SE (BrSE) between the customer and the offshore team (progress reports and quality checks before delivery, requirements specs (SRS), test cases, PoCs, checking AI-generated output). Requires practical Python, basic AI/ML or LLM knowledge, prompt engineering and JLPT N2+; RAG, LangChain and ASPICE are a plus. Flow: document screening with a casual online meeting, then two interviews with division heads; an executive interview is usually not needed.
facts.ja: 車載分野のAIエンジニアは、お客様とオフショアのチームをつなぐ役割を担うと拝見しました。

facts.text: Experienced-hire ADAS Perception development lead (Tokyo/Nagoya): computer vision, object detection, AI recognition on GPU/SoC, model conversion and quantization, ISO 26262 and ASPICE. Its flow is document screening, a 1st interview online and a 2nd in person, plus an aptitude test (personality and cognitive ability).
facts.ja: ADASの認識開発では、GPUやSoCへの実装や量子化にも取り組まれていると拝見しました。

facts.text: Reported (anonymous review site): in a 2026 new-graduate 1st interview held online, a candidate was asked to explain their research so that a general engineer could understand it.
METI and MLIT's Mobility DX Strategy (May 2024; updated June 2025) targets about a 30% Japanese share of the global SDV market in 2030 and 2035.
facts.ja: 日本政府は、2030年と2035年に、世界のSDV販売で日系シェア3割を目指しています。

facts.text: METI estimates Japan's IT-worker shortage in 2030 at up to about 790,000 in the high-demand scenario (about 450,000 in the middle case).
facts.ja: 2030年には、IT人材が最大で約79万人不足するという試算があります。

facts.text: Japanese OEMs rely heavily on external partners for advanced software development. Yano Research puts the SDV-related market at ¥876.6 billion (2025), rising to about ¥2 trillion (2030).
facts.ja: 日本の自動車メーカーは、ソフトウェア開発で、外部のパートナーも活用していると言われます。

facts.text: ATEC, a Japanese automotive software developer with AUTOSAR expertise, chose FPT for its first international collaboration (July 2025), citing resource shortages and a lack of senior embedded and automotive engineers. A new offshore development center is planned in Ho Chi Minh City.
facts.ja: 車載ソフトウェアの分野では、経験のある技術者の不足が課題になっています。

facts.text: ISO 26262 (機能安全, functional safety) covers hazards caused by malfunctions in electrical and electronic systems. ASIL levels run from A to D, with D the strictest.
facts.ja: 機能安全とは、電子システムの故障による危険を減らすための考え方です。

facts.text: ISO 21448 SOTIF (意図した機能の安全性) covers hazards that occur without any failure, from performance limits, the environment or misuse. It complements ISO 26262 and was published on 30 June 2022.
facts.ja: SOTIFは、故障がなくても、性能の限界などで起きる危険を扱う規格です。

facts.text: Driving-automation levels: 0 none, 1 driver assistance, 2 partial automation (the driver still detects and responds to objects and events), 3 conditional, 4 high, 5 full. From level 3, the system performs the entire driving task; levels 3 and 4 work only within limited conditions, and at level 3 the driver must take over when the system asks.
facts.ja: レベル3からは、システムが運転操作の全てを行います。ただし、レベル3と4は、決められた条件の中だけです。

facts.text: Reported: the 2025 Offshore Development White Paper says Vietnam is the #1 offshore destination for Japanese firms (43%; China 21%, India 14%), mainly to secure development resources.
facts.ja: 日本企業のオフショア開発先として、ベトナムが最も多いという調査もあります。

talkingPoints.angle: AI and automotive are focus areas of the FPT group
talkingPoints.ja: 御社グループは2024年に、AIや自動車を重点分野にすると発表されました。成長の中心となる分野で、AIエンジニアとして貢献したいと考えております。

talkingPoints.angle: Your perception research matches FPT's ADAS work
talkingPoints.ja: 御社はADASの認識開発で、SoCへの実装や量子化にも取り組まれていると拝見しました。研究で積んだ、精度と速度を両立させる経験を生かせると考えております。

talkingPoints.angle: FPT helps solve Japan's automotive-software talent gap
talkingPoints.ja: 日本ではSDVへの移行が進む一方で、車載ソフトウェアの技術者不足が課題だと言われています。日本と海外のチームをつなぐ御社で、この課題の解決に貢献したいです。
御社は、自動車産業が集まる群馬県太田市にも拠点を開設されています。お客様の近くで開発を支える姿勢に、共感しております。

talkingPoints.angle: From cloud training to in-car inference
talkingPoints.ja: 御社グループは、日本でAIファクトリーを運営されています。車の中でAIを動かす取り組みも進めていると拝見しました。クラウドでの学習から車での推論まで、幅広く学べる点に魅力を感じております。
御社は2005年から、日本で事業を続けています。2026年には、日本での売上高が1,000億円に達したと発表されました。『日本の元気をITから』というメッセージにも、共感しております。

talkingPoints.angle: A diverse culture that keeps learning
talkingPoints.ja: 御社では、37の国籍の社員が働いていると拝見しました。D&I AWARDで2年連続ベストワークプレイスに選ばれた点にも、魅力を感じました。多様な仲間と、学び続けたいと考えております。
車載のAIには、機能安全や品質プロセスが欠かせません。御社グループは、ISO 26262やA-SPICEレベル3に対応されています。そのため、安全を重視した開発を、実務の中で学べると考えました。

talkingPoints.angle: The bridge role fits your profile
talkingPoints.ja: 御社の研修は、1年以内にお客様と開発チームの架け橋になることが目標だと拝見しました。私も日本語と英語、母語を生かして、その役割を担いたいです。

talkingPoints.angle: Optional, for Vietnamese speakers only: the Japan–Vietnam bridge (add one sentence at most; keep your main reason technical)
talkingPoints.ja: ベトナム出身として、日本とベトナムが連携して開発する御社の体制にも、魅力を感じております。

reverseQuestions.ja: 約3か月の研修のあと、配属先はどのように決まるのでしょうか。
reverseQuestions.en: After the roughly three-month training, how are assignments decided?
reverseQuestions.why: Shows you read the new-graduate posting and care about your path after training.

reverseQuestions.ja: 新入社員の方が、最初の1年で特に苦労されることは何でしょうか。
reverseQuestions.en: What do new employees find hardest in their first year?
reverseQuestions.why: Shows realism and a wish to prepare early.

reverseQuestions.ja: 御社で活躍されている若手社員の方には、どのような共通点がありますか。
reverseQuestions.en: What do the young employees who do well at your company have in common?
reverseQuestions.why: Shows you want to adapt to the company's expectations and grow quickly.

reverseQuestions.ja: 入社までに、日本語や技術の面で準備しておくべきことがあれば、教えていただけますか。
reverseQuestions.en: If there is anything I should prepare in Japanese or technical skills before joining, could you tell me?
reverseQuestions.why: Signals commitment and a Lifelong Learning mindset.

reverseQuestions.ja: 多くの国籍の社員の方が働く中で、チームで大切にされていることは何でしょうか。
reverseQuestions.en: With employees of many nationalities, what do teams value most?
reverseQuestions.why: Connects to One team and the 37 nationalities; shows interest in the culture.

reverseQuestions.ja: 車載AIのプロジェクトでは、新入社員はどのような役割から始めることが多いのでしょうか。
reverseQuestions.en: In in-vehicle AI projects, what role do new employees usually start with?
reverseQuestions.why: Concrete and job-focused; shows you are already picturing the work.

reverseQuestions.ja: 日本のお客様とベトナムのチームの間で、仕様はどのように共有されているのでしょうか。
reverseQuestions.en: How are specifications shared between Japanese customers and the teams in Vietnam?
reverseQuestions.why: Shows you understand the onsite and offshore delivery model and the bridge role.

reverseQuestions.ja: ADASの認識開発では、量子化やSoCへの実装は、どのチームが担当されているのでしょうか。
reverseQuestions.en: In ADAS perception work, which team handles model quantization and deployment to SoCs?
reverseQuestions.why: Shows technical understanding linked to your Jetson experience.

reverseQuestions.ja: 車載AIの開発では、機能安全やSOTIFを、どの段階から考慮されているのでしょうか。
reverseQuestions.en: At what stage do you take functional safety and SOTIF into account in in-vehicle AI development?
reverseQuestions.why: Signals awareness of safety beyond accuracy.

reverseQuestions.ja: LLMを使った車載向けの案件は、今後どのように増えていくとお考えでしょうか。
reverseQuestions.en: How do you expect in-vehicle projects using LLMs to grow?
reverseQuestions.why: Shows interest in AI-defined vehicles and FPT's LLM-related automotive roles.

reverseQuestions.ja: 2033年までに日本のIT企業トップ13入りを目指すと拝見しました。その中で、自動車分野にはどのような役割を期待されていますか。
reverseQuestions.en: I read that you aim to be among Japan's top 13 IT companies by 2033. In that plan, what role do you expect the automotive business to play?
reverseQuestions.why: A strategy question for executives; shows you follow recent announcements. Check the goal's latest wording first.

reverseQuestions.ja: 御社は「AI First Company」を掲げていると拝見しました。若手のAIエンジニアに、最も期待されることは何でしょうか。
reverseQuestions.en: I read that your company upholds the 'AI First Company' vision. What do you expect most from young AI engineers?
reverseQuestions.why: Shows alignment with the vision and asks how you can contribute.

reverseQuestions.ja: 日本の自動車業界がSDVへ移行する中で、御社の強みはどこにあるとお考えでしょうか。
reverseQuestions.en: As Japan's auto industry moves to SDVs, where do you see your company's strength?
reverseQuestions.why: Invites the executive to talk about strategy; shows industry awareness.

reverseQuestions.ja: 入社1年目の社員に、最も期待されることを教えていただけますか。
reverseQuestions.en: Could you tell me what you expect most from first-year employees?
reverseQuestions.why: A classic final-round question that shows commitment; connect the answer to your strengths.

reverseQuestions.ja: 日本とベトナムをつなぐ会社として、今後どのような文化を大切にしたいとお考えでしょうか。
reverseQuestions.en: As a company that connects Japan and Vietnam, what culture do you want to value going forward?
reverseQuestions.why: A values question suited to executives; shows interest in culture fit.

avoidQuestions.ja: 御社の主な事業は何ですか。
avoidQuestions.why: The website already answers this; it shows you did no research.

avoidQuestions.ja: 給料やボーナスは、どのくらいですか。
avoidQuestions.why: Pay and holidays in a first interview can look like your main interest; check the posting, or ask HR after an offer.

avoidQuestions.ja: 残業は多いですか。休みは取りやすいですか。
avoidQuestions.why: Sounds as if you want to avoid work; if needed, ask positively about working style later in the process.
Having no question is rated lowest; it suggests low interest.

avoidQuestions.ja: 先ほどの説明を、もう一度教えてください。
avoidQuestions.why: Repeating what was just explained shows you were not listening; build on it instead (「先ほど〜と伺いましたが、〜」).

verifyBeforeInterview: Which company would employ you (FPT Software Japan or another FPT Japan company), and whether the role sits in the FPT Automotive Japan (FA) division.
Whether there is a new-graduate AI engineer (automotive) role for your graduation year and what it requires; no 2028 engineer posting was live on 2026-11-24.
The selection flow: number of rounds, aptitude-test type, and whether there is a coding test or a Japanese test.
Whether new graduates start work in Japan or train in Vietnam first (a closed automotive new-grad post said training is mainly in Vietnam).
Work location and client-site work: FA lists many locations, and staff placed at clients follow the client's working hours.
Support for changing your residence status to a work visa; nothing about international students was found on the recruiting pages.
The latest numbers (Japan revenue, headcount, nationalities). The ¥100 billion figure has no stated period, so give the year of the announcement (2026).
The 2033 top-13 goal: it is in FPT's English release of 18 November 2026 but not in the Japanese release, so check the latest wording before you quote it.
The supercomputer rank: #36 is from the June 2025 TOP500 list, and the Japan system was #56 on the November 2026 list, so always say 2025年6月.
The status of partnerships (DENSO, Subaru, Mitsubishi Motors): an MoU is a 覚書, not a contract; check for newer news.
Interview format (online or in person), length and language; interviewers may not be native Japanese speakers.
